$schema-note: THE SINGLE SOURCE of this app's design tokens. tailwind.config.js READS this file; it does not
define tokens of its own. Change a value here and it reaches every component.
Extracted VERBATIM from tailwind.config.js on 2026-08-14 — a move, not a redesign. No value was
retuned on the way across, so the rendered result is byte-identical to the inline definition it
Not to be confused with brand/logo/artifacts/meta/tokens.json, which holds the BRAND identity
(logoId, logoVersion, the generator's colour inputs). Two systems, two files, both correct.
name: adrag-warm

color.$note: A warm neutral ramp, stone-derived. 850 and 750 are off-scale intermediates the default Tailwind stone palette does not provide — they exist for the layered surfaces in the chat and pipeline-tracker views.

font.$note: Loaded from Google Fonts in public/index.html. Changing a family here does NOT change what is fetched — update the <link> too.

motion.$note: Durations and easings are part of the theme; the keyframes they drive stay in tailwind.config.js because they are CSS structure, not design values.
